{{Top|leg}}
'''PaAR''' was an acronym used by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force|Defense Force]] which stood for ''planning and analysis rooms''. Located in a facility known as the [[Defense Force Command Compound|Dark Star]], these chambers were constructed deep in the crust of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dark Nest III: The Swarm War">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>
